summary: Waters Corporation filed an 8-K on August 21, 2026, disclosing that Robert L. Carpio III, Senior Vice President of the Waters Analytical Sciences Division, notified the company on August 17, 2026 of his resignation to pursue other opportunities, relinquishing duties effective August 20, 2026. Separately, Waters announced that Tina Wu, Senior Vice President of the Materials Sciences Division and President, China, will assume the Analytical Sciences Division role. No terms, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory mechanics were disclosed. The abrupt senior leadership transition is the event; watch execution risk and any further management turnover.
